name: Instant Clarity
original_name: インスタントクラリティー
source:
A collection of two stories.
Episode 1 tells a love story between protagonist and childhood friend Miharu. But he starts to lose grip with the reality and through delusions relations between two people take another shape.
Episode 2 is an incest story between siblings... coercion, insult and intimidation... can these elements bring a happy ending?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两个故事的合集。
第一集讲述了主人公和青梅竹马三春之间的爱情故事。但他开始失去对现实的掌控，通过妄想，两个人之间的关系呈现出另一种形态。
第二集是一个姐弟之间的乱伦故事……胁迫、侮辱、恐吓……这些元素能否带来幸福的结局？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
